Discard all sites except those winner rules or with an intact edifice; shuffle discarded sites into site deck, discard their denizens, return relics to relic deck and ruined edifices to Archive. At retained sites winner does not rule, flip intact edifice to ruin and discard all denizens there. Set aside **all sites with ruins**, with attached ruins, remaining denizens and relics, in map order top Cradle to bottom Hinterland. Remove pawns/favor/secrets/warbands from map.

Fill Provinces top-down by pushing up then importing Hinterland top-down. Push Hinterland sites up. Fill empty Hinterland slots **bottom-up** with set-aside ruins **bottom-up**, then empty Provinces slots similarly. Fill any remaining slots with facedown site-deck cards; in each region with no faceup site, flip top one up.

Choose among tied suits; no suited advisers → choose any. Suit cycle Discord→Arcane→Order→Hearth→Beast→Nomad→Discord. If Archive cannot supply the full allocation, do **not** add that allocation: heal Archive instead. Sort all Dispossessed by suit; take 6 random from largest Dispossessed suit stack into world deck; shuffle remaining Dispossessed into matching Archive suit stacks.

4. **Repack map slots:** excluding set-aside ruins, fill Cradle top-down by pushing Cradle sites up then importing Provinces then Hinterland in top-down order. Fill Provinces top-down by pushing up then importing Hinterland top-down. Push Hinterland sites up. Fill empty Hinterland slots **bottom-up** with set-aside ruins **bottom-up**, then empty Provinces slots similarly. Fill any remaining slots with facedown site-deck cards; in each region with no faceup site, flip top one up.
5. **Add 6 denizens:** winner's most common adviser suit determines 3 random Archive cards, next clockwise suit 2, next clockwise suit 1, to world deck. If Archive cannot supply the full allocation, do **not** add that allocation: heal Archive instead. Sort all Dispossessed by suit; take 6 random from largest Dispossessed suit stack into world deck; shuffle remaining Dispossessed into matching Archive suit stacks.
